lines.zh: 我的壳在走动时嘎吱响。
lines.en: My shell creaks as I move.
I carry layer upon layer of shell.
I press over the gravel, step by step.

lines.zh: 壳缝里塞满了钳兽的碎甲。
lines.en: Pincer-beast fragments fill my shell's seams.
I stop every so often as I walk.
My weight makes the ground sink.
I drag my belly plate forward.
Originium powder coats me all over.
I am like a fruit that grew legs.
My shell shifts toward your smell.

lines.zh: 我擦过一块石头，刮下一层粉。
lines.en: I brush a rock and scrape off a layer of powder.
Broken shell bits mark my path.

lines.zh: 我立着，慢慢涨大又缩回。
lines.en: I stand, slowly swelling and shrinking.
My shell never stops creaking.
I press my belly plate to the ground.
I wait for a large meal.
I taste the smells in the air.

lines.zh: 源石在我身上结了一层皮。
lines.en: Originium has crusted over me.
My joints rub against each other.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候最像一块石头。
lines.en: Still, I look most like a stone.
I am digesting, slowly.
There is an old crack on my shell.

lines.zh: 你的汗味隔着壳都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell your sweat through my shell.
I turn my whole body slowly.
Something rolls inside my shell.
You are much softer than a stone.

lines.zh: 我加了五百多点的分量。
lines.en: I carry five hundred weight and more.

lines.zh: 你靠近一步，壳就响一声。
lines.en: One step closer and my shell creaks.
Step back; the ground will give way.
I point the edge of my shell at you.
I have swallowed things larger than you.
You grip a weapon, but you are too light.
A corner broke off my shell.
Shell powder falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，很慢才回过神。
lines.en: I halt, slow to recover.
The crack has deepened.
I do not cry out; I only press lower.
Shards slide off my back.
What is inside shrinks back.
I slowly shift my balance.
There are a few more pieces of my shell on the ground.
I can bear this much damage.
What have you brought?

lines.zh: 味道过来，我慢慢张开壳。
lines.en: The smell comes near, and I slowly open.
Set it before me. Do not throw it.
This will not fill a seam.

lines.zh: 我把它连同土一起吞了。
lines.en: I swallow it, soil and all.

lines.zh: 壳缝里的碎甲又要多一块。
lines.en: Another fragment for my seams.
Do not put your hand inside.
That smell wakes my appetite.
More. I am still hungry.
My chewing must sound awful.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是我背上那层壳。
lines.en: What you hit is the shell on my back.
The shove moved me half an inch.
Shell powder flies up from the impact.
Your shoulder struck solidly.
I press back, far heavier than you.

lines.zh: 地上的碎石被我们碾碎。
lines.en: We crush the gravel between us.
That barely registered.

lines.zh: 我的壳边缘蹭到你的腿。
lines.en: My shell's edge scrapes your leg.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我还在原地。
lines.en: You stepped back; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 再挤一次，你会被碾过去。
lines.en: Push again and you will be crushed.
Do you want a share as well?

lines.zh: 我们两个太重了，地会陷。
lines.en: The two of us are too heavy; the ground will sink.
My shell has a few more layers now.

lines.zh: 我不分食，这是我唯一的原则。
lines.en: I do not share food. That is my only rule.
Stand further off while you eat.
Shell on shell leaves powder.
We each take our own direction.

lines.zh: 你可以跟着我，捡我落下的。
lines.en: You may follow and pick up what I drop.
I chase smells, not people.
This ground is empty enough already.
I push it with the edge of my shell.
It has stuck to my belly plate.

lines.zh: 我连同碎石一起卷进来。
lines.en: I roll it in together with the gravel.
This will not fill a tooth gap.
One more small thing in my seams.
I press it slowly into my shell.
Too little to even taste.
I have taken it. No one gets it.
I crushed it.
A little debris remains on the ground.
You smell edible.
I roll slowly toward you.
A seam of my shell has opened.
I have locked on you and will not change.
You are retreating straight at a wall.
My weight will speak for me.
So many shell layers. Hard to chew, is it not?
I have sped up, slow as that is.

lines.zh: 钳兽的壳粉，撑着我这副身子。
lines.en: Crab-shell powder holds this body up.

lines.zh: 我要把你连装备一起吞。
lines.en: I will swallow you, gear and all.
I do not fear your weapon.
You stamp the ground very loudly.
Hungry so long my shell feels hollow.
Wherever you run, I can smell you.
I push forward and shorten the distance.
Just stay where you are.
I close in an inch at a time.
My shell's seam faces your way.

lines.zh: 地面的碎石在我身下碎。
lines.en: Gravel crunches beneath me.
I wait for you to step into soft earth.
The wind carries your scent to me.
I am in no hurry; one should eat slowly.

lines.zh: 我腹下的碎石，全被压成粉。
lines.en: The rubble under me is ground to powder.
You have been forced against the rocks.
This shell dust comes off at a touch.
The inside of my shell is empty, and it aches.
I drift left and block that route.
Looking up will not help.
The earth under me begins to sink.
Your heavy breathing reaches me.
One more step and I can reach.
I have shifted my weight forward.
Do not move; moving makes me hungrier.
The ground behind you has loosened.
I open my shell as wide as it goes.
Now — come in.
I press down with the whole of my shell.
My weight crushes the stone bricks.
My shell's edge bites into your armor.

lines.zh: 你被挤在我和石头之间。
lines.en: You are wedged between me and the stone.
I roll you into my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也沉了半尺。
lines.en: That one sank me half a foot too.
Bone makes a brittle sound.
Struggle, and I press harder.
I crush before I chew.
You have scratched my shell.

lines.zh: 我退了半寸，是给你让位。
lines.en: I withdrew half an inch to make room.

lines.zh: 壳张开了，你该明白意思。
lines.en: My shell is open. You should take the meaning.
I swallowed a great lump of earth.
Powder and blood mix on the ground.
I press down again.
This meal is hard work.
I close my shell slowly.
You are still outside. But not for long.
Hot air hisses from my seam.
Now you are in my seams.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，带着壳。
lines.en: I heave up out of the soil, shell and all.

lines.zh: 一层层碎甲堆在我背上。
lines.en: Layer on layer of broken shell heaps on my back.
Originium gathered in the earth and became me.

lines.zh: 地面沉了一下，我站起来了。
lines.en: The ground sank, and I rose.
Shell powder scatters off me.
My shell's crown shows first.
This thing has been hungry a long while.

lines.zh: 石头和甲片粘在一起，成了我。
lines.en: Stone and plate fused into what I am.
A pincer tip comes out first.

lines.zh: 周围的碎石都被压平了。
lines.en: The gravel around has been pressed flat.
I rise, taller than the stones.

lines.zh: 地面上还有我留下的粉。
lines.en: Powder marks the ground where I have been.
My shell blackens and smokes.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，壳震得直响。
lines.en: I crash to the ground and my shell rings.
Water seeps into my shell and it grows heavy.
The blast stripped a layer off my shell.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进壳缝里，卡住了。
lines.en: Something wedged into a seam and stuck.

lines.zh: 源石在我身上嗡嗡作响。
lines.en: The originium on me hums and buzzes.
My shell has been empty too long; I feel hollow.
Lightning strikes my shell and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，壳也带不动我。
lines.en: I sink, and my shell cannot save me.
